entries.summary: There is no consensus on the reliability of the Washington Examiner, but there is consensus that it should not be used to substantiate exceptional claims.

entries.name: WatchMojo
entries.summary: WatchMojo is a site that publishes Internet videos consisting of ranking listicles.

entries.name: WCD-WCE-WRD
entries.summary: Additional considerations apply to the use of the World Christian Database, World Christian Encyclopedia, and World Religion Database.

entries.name: We Got This Covered
entries.summary: We Got This Covered is generally unreliable due to its lack of editorial oversight, publication of unsubstantiated or false rumors, speculation claimed as fact, and accepting contributions from non-staff contributors.

entries.name: Weather2Travel
entries.summary: Weather2Travel is a website operated by UK-based Global Support Limited.

entries.name: Wen Wei Po
entries.summary: Wen Wei Po is a newspaper owned by the government of Hong Kong.

entries.name: WhatCulture
entries.summary: WhatCulture is considered generally unreliable.

entries.name: Who's Who (UK)
entries.summary: Who's Who (UK) is considered generally unreliable due to its poor editorial standards and history of publishing false or inaccurate information.

entries.name: WhoSampled
entries.summary: WhoSampled is almost entirely composed of user-generated content, and is a self-published source.

entries.name: Wikidata
entries.summary: Wikidata is largely user-generated, and articles should not directly cite Wikidata as a source (just as it would be inappropriate to cite other Wikipedias' articles as sources).

entries.name: Wikidata transcluded statements
entries.summary: Uniquely among WMF sites, Wikidata's statements can be directly transcluded into articles; this is usually done to provide external links or infobox data.

entries.name: WikiLeaks
entries.summary: WikiLeaks is a repository of primary source documents leaked by anonymous sources.

entries.name: Wikinews
entries.summary: Most editors believe that Wikinews articles do not meet Wikipedia's verifiability standards.

entries.name: Wikipedia
entries.summary: Wikipedia itself is not an appropriate source because open wikis are self-published sources.

entries.name: Wired
entries.summary: Wired magazine is considered generally reliable for science and technology.

entries.name: WordPress.com
entries.summary: WordPress.com is a blog hosting service that runs on the WordPress software.

entries.name: World Socialist Web Site
entries.summary: The World Socialist Web Site is the online news and information publication of the International Committee of the Fourth International, a Trotskyist political organisation.

entries.name: WorldNetDaily
entries.summary: WorldNetDaily was deprecated in the 2018 RfC.

entries.name: Worldometer
entries.summary: Worldometer is a self-published source and editors have questioned its accuracy and methodology.

entries.name: X
entries.summary: X (formerly known as Twitter before July 2023) is a social network.

entries.name: XBIZ
entries.summary: XBIZ is considered generally reliable for the adult industry.

entries.name: Xinhua News Agency
entries.summary: Xinhua News Agency is the official state-run press agency of the People's Republic of China.

entries.name: Yahoo News
entries.summary: Yahoo!

entries.name: YouTube
entries.summary: Most videos on YouTube are anonymous, self-published, and unverifiable, and should not be used as a reference.

entries.name: ZDNet (October 2020–present)
entries.summary: ZDNet was acquired by digital marketing company Red Ventures in October 2020.

entries.name: ZDNet (pre–October 2020)
entries.summary: ZDNet is considered generally reliable for technology-related articles prior to its acquisition by Red Ventures in October 2020.

entries.name: Zero Hedge
entries.summary: Zero Hedge was deprecated in the 2020 RfC due to its propagation of conspiracy theories.

entries.name: ZoomInfo
entries.summary: Due to persistent abuse, ZoomInfo is currently on the Wikipedia spam blacklist, and links must be whitelisted before they can be used.
